description: Bike Racks_Post and Ring, and Bulk is a dataset listed in City of Edmonton open data portal (data.edmonton.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Edmonton. This dataset provides information on the location of all the post and ring bike racks maintained by Transportation Services in the Edmonton. Coverage: Edmonton. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are cycling, parking, bike racks, bike parking. The table has 22 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Edmonton. The portal shows 2025-02-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-edmonton-ca-portal.
